summary: Completed backend and mobile UI regression testing. Auth, logout token revocation, fresh login, settings persistence, member/payment calculations, expiry filters, reports, navigation, save feedback, and mobile overflow checks passed.
action_items: Consider replacing wildcard CORS configuration with explicit configured origins before enabling credentialed browser sessions.
Address the existing React exhaustive-deps warning in Members.load when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: Logout now persists JWT jti revocation and reused tokens receive 401; fresh tokens remain usable.
Settings PUT/GET persistence is working against SQLite and the mobile Settings page reflects save confirmation.
seed_data_creation: Regression suite created TEST Flow Member records and payments in development SQLite; settings was changed to Mobile Verify Gym during UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested full flow is passing. Continue with any newly added member assignment/payment UI if exposed in a later build.
rca of the issue: Previous logout vulnerability is resolved by storing JWT jti values in revoked_tokens and checking the denylist in auth(). Previous settings gap is resolved with SQLite settings persistence and wired GET/PUT UI integration. The one browser automation finding was a malformed JavaScript diagnostic selector in the test harness, not an application failure.
